# ArcCentrx

> ArcCentrx is a consulting and execution firm for enterprise and mid-market companies facing transformation, scale, transaction, technology, and operating challenges. It brings management consulting and deep operational experience into one team that defines the plan and runs it: eight standalone services, delivered through one methodology (Assess, Align, Accelerate). Tagline: Strategy Built to Run.

ArcCentrx, LLC is based in Henderson, Nevada. The founding team has overseen $2 billion in technology spend, worked with 25+ Fortune 500 companies, and been part of 6 exits. Clients can scope one service or several.

## Services

- [AI Strategy](https://arccentrx.com/services.html#ai-strategy): AI spend and utilization audits, use case prioritization, workflow redesign, model governance, build versus buy.
- [Growth Strategy](https://arccentrx.com/services.html#growth-strategy): segmentation and ICP, pricing and packaging, sales infrastructure and CRM, funnel analysis, market entry.
- [Technology Infrastructure](https://arccentrx.com/services.html#technology-infrastructure): architecture and scalability, payments and ledger design, KYC and onboarding, sponsor bank strategy, platform migration.
- [Operational Optimization](https://arccentrx.com/services.html#operational-optimization): process redesign, cost to serve, cost takeout, quality and rework reduction, vendor rationalization.
- [M&A Readiness and Integration](https://arccentrx.com/services.html#ma-readiness): sell-side readiness, buy-side diligence, integration planning, systems consolidation, synergy tracking.
- [Compliance and Governance](https://arccentrx.com/services.html#compliance-governance): SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI, accessibility, state licensing, AI and model governance, audit readiness.
- [Organizational Design](https://arccentrx.com/services.html#organizational-design): operating model, roles and accountability, decision rights, workforce planning, leadership team design.
- [Reporting and Analytics](https://arccentrx.com/services.html#reporting-analytics): metric definitions, executive and board reporting, dashboards, data pipeline review, reporting automation.

## How engagements run

- [Methodology](https://arccentrx.com/methodology.html): every engagement runs in order. Assess what is actually going on, Align the teams on a direction, then Accelerate delivery, with the same people from plan through execution.

## Industries

- [ArcCentrx for Fintech](https://arccentrx.com/fintech.html): operating inside the fintech stack since 2013, covering issuing, processing, sponsor bank relationships, program management, compliance, and go-to-market.
- [ArcCentrx for Credit Unions](https://arccentrx.com/credit-unions.html): outcome-first help for member-owned institutions with $100M+ in share deposits facing conversions, renegotiations, mergers, or major technology decisions.
- [ArcCentrx for Healthcare](https://arccentrx.com/healthcare.html): healthcare market entry, covering demand assessment, launch readiness, referral and buyer relationships, and channel strategy.
